https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/joe-burrow.headline: The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero reports Joe Burrow (back) will play in Week 2 against the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/joe-burrow.analysis: The Bengals called up Josh Johnson from the practice squad over the weekend, raising some eyebrows regarding Burrow’s health. The move, however, was purely a precaution. Burrow has already said he is playing this week. He remains near the top of the QB1 ranks despite a tough matchup with the Houston defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/joe-burrow.headline: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) is questionable to play in Week 2 against the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/joe-burrow.analysis: This listing is effectively a formality. Burrow laughed off the idea of missing the Bengals’ game against the Texans earlier this week, and today, coach Zac Taylor said Burrow is “good to go” after practicing in full. Burrow’s status is, of course, worth following, but we do expect him to play. Treat him as a QB1, per usual.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Chiefs declared CB Mansoor Delane, QB Garrett Nussmeier, FB Ben VanSumeren, DE Jack Pyburn, OT Diego Pounds, and DT Peter Woods inactive for Week 9 against the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: The Kansas City defense will be without Delane against a Geno Smith-led Jets passing attack that showed out last week against the Raiders. The Chiefs this season are allowing the NFL’s 13th lowest EPA per drop back and rank 15th in drop back success rate allowed.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Chiefs declared CB Mansoor Delane, QB Garrett Nussmeier, FB Ben VanSumeren, DE Jack Pyburn, OT Diego Pounds, and DE Tyreke Smith inactive for Week 8 against the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: Delane was initially listed as questionable for Week 8 on Friday. He was then ruled out over the weekend. Rookie EDGE R Mason Thomas was questionable for personal reasons but is active.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Chiefs downgraded Mansoor Delane (shoulder) to out for Week 8 against the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: Delane entered the weekend listed as questionable for the team’s divisional showdown against the Broncos, ultimately downgraded to out on Saturday. His absence could influence Steve Spagnuolo’s ability to utilize man coverage at the hefty rates he has through the first six games.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) is questionable for Kansas City’s Week 8 game against the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: Delane didn’t practice either of the last two days after popping on to the injury report on Thursday. Andy Reid could only muster a “We’ll see how he does here going forward” when asked about it. We’d consider him on the pessimistic side of questionable.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) did not practice Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: Delane’s absence raises concerns surrounding his potential availability when the Broncos in Week 8. Coming off their first loss of the season, the Chiefs will look to rebound against a divisional opponent after managing only three points against the Seahawks. Delane has been a big part of defensive coordinator Steve Spagnuolo’s weekly game plan, allowing the team to rank near the top of the league in man coverage rate through the first third of the season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Chiefs DT Chris Jones (calf) is questionable to play in Week 2 against the Colts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: Chiefs CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder) is also questionable to play this week, though Chiefs coach Andy Reid said earlier this week “there’s a pretty good chance” Delane will suit up in Week 1. Jones remained limited all week. Delane logged two full sessions before downgrading to limited on Friday, which could indicate he suffered a setback. We will find out soon enough.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said “there’s a pretty good chance” Mansoor Delane (shoulder) is in uniform and available for Week 2 against the Colts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: Delane left Week 1 with a right shoulder injury and did not return. He underwent X-rays after exiting the game and the results were negative. Reid specifically said he expects Delane to be available, but that doesn’t rule out a reserve role if the team wants to play it safe with the rookie. He is expected to practice today, presumably in a limited capacity.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Chiefs CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder) left Week 1’s win over the Broncos and will have an MRI on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: X-Rays were negative and Delane’s shoulder was stable after he left upon falling down on his interception three snaps in. We saw plenty of L’Jarius Sneed in Week 1’s win over the Broncos, with Kristian Fulton also joining the fold against three-wide sets. The Chiefs are hoping the No. 6 overall pick won’t be sidelined too long.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Chiefs CB Mansoor Delane was seen in a full-contact jersey on Monday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: Sporting a full-contact jersey and shoulder pads for the first time in training camp, Delane appears set to be a full-go for the Chiefs. The first-round rookie had been recovering from a shoulder injury he suffered earlier this offseason and was practicing on a limited basis in camp after avoiding the PUP list. With roughly three weeks to go before the start of the season, Delane appears to be on track to play in Week 1 against the Broncos.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.headline: Chiefs CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder) said he is hoping to be fully cleared for camp “some time soon.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mansoor-de.analysis: Delane suffered a shoulder injury this offseason at OTAs and was sporting a non-contact jersey at the Chiefs’ first training camp. The No. 6 overall pick in this year’s draft said things are “getting better every day” and has spent most of his time in the playbook and conditioning. The fact he didn’t open camp on the PUP list suggests this is a relatively minor injury for Delane, who is expected to provide an immediate boost to a new-look secondary that last starting corners Trent McDuffie (trade) and Jaylen Watson (free agency) to the Rams this offseason.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-wal.headline: Colts declared TE Pharaoh Brown, LB Akeem Davis-Gaither, S AJ Haulcy, OT Charlie Heck, QB Riley Leonard, TE Will Mallory, and CB Justin Walley in active for Week 9 against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-wal.analysis: No real surprises here as the Colts limp into their final game before the league’s trade deadline. That said there remains legitimate uncertainty surrounding the usages of Jonathan Taylor and Josh Downs, amongst others, in what could be their final game with the franchise.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-wal.headline: Colts CB Justin Walley (knee) participated in OTAs last week.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-wal.analysis: Walley tore his ACL last August in training camp after a promising offseason that seemed to have him as a possibility to start right away. It looks like he’ll be full-go in training camp and should have a decent shot at starting. The 80th overall pick in the draft in 2025, Walley’s absence was a big part of the reason the Colts dealt for Sauce Gardner at midseason last year, and it sounds like he could replace Kenny Moore in the slot for the Colts in 2026.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-wal.headline: Colts third-round CB Justin Walley suffered a torn ACL in Thursday’s preseason opener and will miss the entire 2025 season.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-wal.analysis: It’s an awful blow for a player Indianapolis media believed was on track to earn a starting job opposite Charvarius Ward. Although it forces the Colts to tap into already questionable cornerback depth, it’s a far worse development for the player, who will already be 23 in September. He will hope for a speedy recovery and that his Day 2 draft pedigree gives him the inside track to a spot on Indy’s 2026 53-man roster.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-wal.headline: Colts selected Minnesota CB Justin Walley with the No. 80 overall pick in the 2025 NFL Draft.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-wal.analysis: A four-year starter at Minnesota, Walley (5’10/190) brings extensive experience (42 starts) and ball production (34 PBUs) to the table, finishing top five in school history in passes defended. Walley graded out consistently in PFF’s coverage metrics, earning a 76.7 in 2023 and 76.2 in 2022 while seeing 55+ targets each of his last three years. His sticky mirror-match footwork from press coverage helped him cling to bigger targets on the outside, but his 5-foot-10 frame and average burst (32” vert, 5.97 RAS) could prompt a move inside. He boasts excellent route recognition and plays with the urgency to dart downhill and disrupt the run, though his physicality can lead to flags — his grabby play style and handsy reps drew concern from scouts. Despite lacking ideal size or elite testing, Walley’s toughness, competitiveness, and savvy zone eyes make him an intriguing selection as a slot corner with special teams upside.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: Broncos declared S Talanoa Hufanga, CB Kris Abrams-Draine, S Brandon Jones, WR Lil’Jordan Humphrey, OG Kage Casey, TE Dallen Bentley, and QB Sam Ehlinger inactive for Week 9 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: Hufanga was questionable entering the weekend due to an ankle injury, but will officially be sidelined for this one. The 28-year-old safety hasn’t played since Week 5 but was limited in back-to-back practices to close out the week, so there’s a chance he could return after the Broncos’ Week 10 bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: The Denver Post’s Parker Gabriel believes Sam Ehlinger could beat out Jarrett Stidham for Denver’s backup quarterback job.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: He projects Ehlinger to win the job, too. “The notion that Ehlinger could beat him out is not rooted in Stidham’s performance in the AFC title game,” Gabriel writes, "...but rather just in the staff’s excitement about Ehlinger a year ago, his mobility and a potential jump in performance in his second summer with the Broncos.” First the NFL hands us a Joe Milton-Sam Howell backup battle, now this? Premium July entertainment. Neither player has any real upside, though whoever wins the job could argue for Sean Payton-based superflex QB2 consideration in a good matchup should Bo Nix miss time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: Broncos re-signed QB Sam Ehlinger to a one-year, $2 million contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: Ehlinger signed with the Broncos last offseason but didn’t make their final roster. He chose to stay on the team’s practice squad despite receiving 53-man roster offers from other teams. He bounced between the practice squad and the active roster throughout the year. With teams reportedly calling Denver about Jarrett Stidham, the Broncos are keeping Ehlinger around as a potential QB2 option should they choose to move their current backup.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: Broncos declared QB Sam Ehlinger, TE Caleb Lohner, WR Elijah Moore, ILB Karene Reid, CB Reese Taylor, OLB Que Robinson, and DL Sai’Vion Jones inactive for the Divisional Round against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: The Broncos begin their path to the Super Bowl as one of the healthier teams in the league after their Wild Card bye as the No. 1 seed in the AFC, enough so that they appear to have elevated two practice squad members, Elijah Moore and Caleb Lohner, to receive a small roster bonus as thanks for their time on the practice squad this season. The home-favorite Broncos face a difficult challenge against the Josh Allen-led Bills as they aim to avoid the same postseason outcome as in 2024 when the Bills bounced the Broncos in a blowout loss.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: Broncos signed QB Sam Ehlinger to the 53-man roster.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: Ehlinger was not elevated for Week 18 while still having one standard elevation remaining, but will now head into the postseason a member of the 53-man, game-day roster. It’ll give the Broncos additional maneuverability during what they hope is a long playoff run as the No. 1 seed in the AFC. The veteran backup chose not to sign with the Colts following the injury to Daniel Jones and was reported to have had discussions with the Broncos regarding their plans moving forward. “We’ve talked about some things for the playoffs,” Ehlinger said ahead of Week 18, hinting at the move made official Monday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: Broncos signed QB Sam Ehlinger off the practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: Ehlinger will not be active for Week 16 against the Jaguars, but the quarterback will get a nicer paycheck will operating as the emergency signal-caller going forward. The 27-year-old was offered a chance to join the Colts’ active roster after the Daniel Jones’ injury, but he declined and chose to stick with Denver. One can’t help but think this is a reward for his loyalty.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: The Denver Post’s Parker Gabriel reports Broncos QB Sam Ehlinger declined the Colts’ offer to sign him to their active roster.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: Ehlinger was originally drafted by the Colts and spent four seasons with the team. He told The Denver Post that he and his agent talked to the Colts for two days before turning down the offer and sticking with the Broncos’ practice squad. The Colts were going for familiarity to fill their quarterback role by trying to get Ehlinger while also getting Philip Rivers. Ehlinger chooses to stay with the Broncos, where he is the third quarterback behind Bo Nix and Jarrett Stidham.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: Broncos signed QB Sam Ehlinger to the active roster.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: Ehlinger has bounced between the active roster and practice squad for the Broncos to start the season. He was briefly released and brought back to the practice squad last week and is now back on the active roster. Ehlinger will continue to sit behind Bo Nix and Jarrett Stidham amidst the Broncos’ roster management ping-ponging his roster status.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: Broncos released QB Sam Ehlinger.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: Ehlinger was released from the team before being re-signed to the practice squad back in August, and later promoted to the active roster. He is expected to be re-signed to the practice squad again shortly, though he is free to pursue employment elsewhere. The Broncos recently activated LB Dre Greenlaw (quad) from injured reserve. Ehlinger’s release was likely done to create space for him.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.headline: Broncos signed QB Sam Ehlinger to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/sam-ehling.analysis: A tale as true as time: the third quarterback was released at last cuts and found his way to the practice squad. Joining Ehlinger on the Broncos practice squad are: G Calvin Throckmorton, CB Reese Taylor, LB Jordan Turner, FB Adam Prentice, WR Michael Bandy, WR A.T. Perry, CB Jaden Robinson, S Delarrin Turner-Yell, ILB Garret Wallow, TE Caleb Lohner, OL Joe Michalski, LB Levelle Bailey and CB Quinton Newsome.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: Eagles declared WR DeVonta Smith, WR Dontayvion Wicks, LB Jihaad Campbell, CB Jonathan Jones, S Michael Carter II and WR Britain Covey inactive for Week 9 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Smith has now been active just one time since Week 3. With the Eagles no longer particularly interested in the 2026 season, we would consider Smith no better than 50-50 to return following the team’s Week 10 bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 9 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: As expected, Smith will miss another week after not being able to practice due to his ankle troubles. The 27-year-old wideout could be an option after the Week 10 bye, but nothing is certain. The Eagles’ passing attack should be completely avoided for their divisional showdown with New York.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Smith will almost certainly miss the Eagles’ Week 9 game against the Giants. Philadelphia goes on bye next week, so fantasy managers will likely have to wait until Week 11 to get Smith back in their lineups. Stay tuned.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) was not seen at the start of Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Smith has been out since Week 6, which was his first game back from a two-week absence. In the middle of a lost season, there’s no reason for the Eagles to rush their star receiver back. We don’t expect him to play this week and it’s possible he’s out for a while longer. Makai Lemon will likely operate as the team’s WR1 once again.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: Eagles declared WR DeVonta Smith, LB Jihaad Campbell, WR Dontayvion Wicks, CB Jonathan Jones, OL Jake Majors , and WR Britain Covey inactive for Week 8 against the Commanders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: The Eagles continue to trudge on without key contributors as they enter Week 8 down their top two wide receivers and starting quarterback. Running back Saquon Barkley is active after being removed from the injury report Friday, with Elijah Mitchell and Jaydon Blue on hand for change of pace duties. Covey’s absence is primarily a hit to the Philadelphia special teams unit, who will continue to require alternate contributions to kick returns.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) will not play in Philadelphia’s Week 8 game against the Commanders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: He has not practiced since Week 6. It’s hard to count on Smith to be up for Week 9, though we obviously can’t say anything beyond him being questionable. The Eagles have a Week 10 bye and it might be preferable for them at this point if Smith sat through that — though that is just our speculation.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith was not spotted at practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Assuming there’s not a non-media practice portion that adds him to the report, Smith will enter Friday as fairly unlikely to play. We’ll see if he can get on the practice field on Friday. A limited session might get him on to the questionable line. Smith last practiced ahead of Week 6.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not participate in Wednesday’s walkthrough practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Both Smith and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) were estimated DNPs for the Eagles’ walkthrough. Both players missed Week 7 against the Cowboys and start off on the wrong side of questionable to open Week 8. Smith and Wicks will need to at least get a limited practice session in before they can be considered as potential fantasy options against the Commanders. With Britain Covey (knee) also DNP, the receiving corps is sparse. If neither can go, Darius Cooper and Hollywood Brown get a boost from the WR group while TE Dallas Goedert becomes the No. 1 pass-catcher in the Eagles offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: Eagles ruled out DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) for Week 7 against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: The Eagles will be without their top two receivers but got good news Saturday with the removal of Dallas Goedert from the injury report. Saquon Barkley is listed as questionable and appears to be a true game-time decision. Considering the low involvement of the backfield in the pass game this season, Goedert stands to benefit the most from the absences at wide receiver. He can be started as an upside TE1 in a solid on-paper matchup against the Cowboys.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.headline: The Philadelphia Inquirer’s Jeff McLane said he got “the sense” that DeVonta Smith (hamstring) will not play in Week 7 against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devonta-sm.analysis: Like Thursday, Smith was sidelined for Friday’s practice. The Eagles have been managing his practice reps and pulled him out for multiple drives in their Week 6 loss to the Panthers. The Eagles face the Cowboys on Monday night, giving Smith an extra day to rest. Consider him highly questionable to play at this time. McLane adds that Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) could also sit out this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports the Broncos are hopeful Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) will play in Week 9 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: Per Fowler, he remains a game-time decision. Hufanga logged two limited practices this week before receiving a questionable designation. Before going down with the injury, Hufanga had one forced fumble and two interceptions, one of which he took to the end zone. Getting him back would be a big win for the Denver defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) is questionable to play in Week 9 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: The Broncos’ talented safety might need another week to get his ankle healthy. Hufanga only logged two limited practice sessions this week. He has been sidelined since mid-October.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) resumed practicing on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: The Broncos’ safety now has a chance to play in Week 9 against the Panthers, though it is possible he still needs another week. Getting Hufanga back in the lineup will help improve a Broncos defense that has somewhat underperformed this year.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: Broncos ruled out Jonah Elliss (ankle) for Week 7 against the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: Reporting from earlier this week indicates Ellis could be sidelined for a few weeks. Broncos S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) was also ruled out this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: Riley Moss (ribs) is questionable for the Broncos’ Week 6 game against the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: Moss missed Week 5 due to a rib injury but has a chance to return Thursday against the Seahawks after three straight limited practices this week. CB Patrick Surtain (ankle) and S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) did not practice all week and were ruled out, as expected.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports that Talanoa Hufanga is expected to miss “about 2-3 weeks” with an ankle injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: The former second-team All-Pro safety left last week’s game against the Chargers with the injury. Hufanga has been one of the biggest havoc creators in the league this year with one forced fumble and two interceptions, one of which was returned for a touchdown. His absence will be a big blow to the Broncos’ defense, which is already without Patrick Surtain II, Jonathon Cooper, and potentially Riley Moss for their Week 6 matchup against the Seahawks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: Broncos CB Riley Moss (ribs) was listed as a limited practice participant on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: Moss was ruled out of Week 5 against the Chargers but has a chance to play Week 6 against the Seahawks with back-to-back limited practice listings. Meanwhile, S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) was a DNP for the second straight day. With Patrick Surtain (ankle) still out in the short term, the Broncos’ banged-up secondary may have a tough time against Jaxon Smith-Njigba and company on Thursday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) did not practice on Monday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: It was an estimated session, but one that probably bodes pretty prescient since Hufanga left Week 5’s game with the ankle injury and was ruled out. Riley Moss (ribs) was listed as limited and would appear to have a chance to come back after being ruled out for Week 5.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: NFL Insider James Palmer reports Broncos S Talanoa Hufanga is “100% healthy and moving well.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: Palmer dropped some quick-hitting notes on Monday’s camp practice, singling out Hufanga as fully healthy. Hufanga agreed to a three-year contract with the Broncos this offseason after coming off consecutive season-ending injuries in 2023 and 2024, the former of which was a torn ACL and the latter being a torn ligament in his wrist. He’ll look to regain his high-level play with the Broncos after earning first-team All-Pro honors in his last fully healthy season in 2022 while with the 49ers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.headline: Broncos agreed to terms with S Talanoa Hufanga, formerly of the 49ers, on a three-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/talanoa-hu.analysis: The deal is worth up to $45 million. Hufanga was a rising star coming out of his second NFL season. He started all 17 games in 2022 and totaled two sacks, nine pass breakups, and four interceptions, one of which was returned for a touchdown. Hufanga then tore his ACL 10 games into the 2023 season. His recovery lasted into the following season and he also missed time with a wrist injury, limiting him to just seven appearances. With a clean bill of health heading into 2025, Hufanga will look to get back on track as part of a Denver defense that ranked third in points allowed last year.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: 49ers placed Christian Kirk (knee) on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: Kirk missed the start of the year with a calf issue and immediately injured his knee in Week 7. The 49ers have already burned several injured reserve return designations this year, including one on Kirk himself. He could ultimately be stuck on IR for the remainder of the year, even if he’s not dealing with a catastrophic knee injury.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: 49ers ruled out Christian Kirk (knee) for Week 9 against the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: At this point, Kirk probably does not need to be rostered in 12-team leagues. He returned from his lengthy calf injury only to injure his knee. It’s a tough break for the veteran wide receiver.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: Christian Kirk (knee) was not spotted at the open portion of Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: Kirk was limited Wednesday with his knee issue, and it’s possible he’ll get that designation again in the closed portion of practice. The 29-year-old still has a decent chance to play in Week 9 against the Raiders, but even with the litany of injuries for the 49ers in their receiving corps, it’s hard to trust Kirk from a fantasy perspective.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: Christian Kirk (knee) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: Kirk comes out of the 49ers’ bye as a limited practice participant due to a knee issue. He was not targeted in Week 7 after returning off a calf injury and should remain off fantasy rosters even if he plays in Week 9 against the Raiders.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: Christian Kirk was not targeted in the 49ers’ Week 7 loss to the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: Kirk was activated off the injured list this week after missing the first six games of the season with a calf injury. He played on just 20 of the team’s 66 snaps and ran a route on 14 of their 43 dropbacks. Kirk was always likely to be eased back into things, and the 49ers have a bye next week to get him more up to speed. That being said, he doesn’t figure to be a huge part of this passing game if the 49ers can get more of their receivers back healthy after the bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: 49ers activated Christian Kirk (calf) from injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: The 49ers would normally have Kirk on a pitch count for his first game of the year. With their top four receivers unavailable for today’s game, Kirk may be thrust into a full-time role right away. He will be in the mix for WR1 duties in San Francisco alongside Brandin Cooks and Jordan Watkins. Kirk is a long-shot FLEX option for his first game as a 49er.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: Christian Kirk (calf) is questionable for San Francisco’s Week 7 game against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: We’ve heard worse desperation options than “most accomplished 49ers wideout on paper playing with Brock Purdy and George Kittle as Mike Evans sits.” Kirk probably factors in the WR3/WR4 calculus after being activated from injured reserve Saturday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: Christian Kirk (calf) practiced in full on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: Kirk is on track to make his 2026 debut this week in the 49ers’ game against the Falcons. As strange as it sounds, Kirk has a chance to vault into the 49ers’ No. 1 wide receiver role with Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring) expected to sit out this week. Kirk should be rostered in 12-team formats.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: Christian Kirk (calf) was a full participant in Wednesday’s walkthrough practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: Kirk was limited all of last week but starts out this week listed as a full participant for the 49ers’ Wednesday walkthrough practice. He remains on injured reserve, but head coach Kyle Shanahan said Kirk is a “possibility” for Week 7. A full practice listing is a good start and Kirk could see WR3 volume immediately with Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel dealing with injuries.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.headline: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Christian Kirk is a “possibility” for Week 7.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/christian-.analysis: Kirk has been on injured reserve with a calf injury but could return to the Niners’ injury-ravaged receivers room this Sunday against the pass-funnel Falcons defense. “He had two good practices (last week). It was just his first two practices of the year,” Shanahan said of Kirk, who last year had 239 yards and a touchdown in 13 regular season games for the Texans. “We were down on wideouts, so it was still something we discussed, but we decided to give it another week.” If Kirk returns and plays something close to a full complement of snaps against Atlanta, he could function as the team’s No. 1 receiver with Mike Evans (Achilles) seemingly unlikely to suit up. Kirk should be rostered in most 12-team leagues and all deeper formats.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Tanner McKee (rib) will serve as the Eagles’ backup quarterback in Week 9 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: McKee was demoted to QB2 after Week 8. He suffered a rib injury in that game, but is healthy enough to hold a clipboard. Joe Milton will make his first career start versus the Giants today.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reports that Tanner McKee will not start in Week 9 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: Joe Milton will start for the Eagles against the Giants this week. McKee’s time under center lasted three games. Unfortunately, he never once threw for more than 215 yards or threw multiple touchdowns. McKee can be dropped in two-quarterback leagues. Milton is a volatile QB2.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: Nick Sirianni said “Tanner (McKee) is our guy” when asked about the team’s quarterback situation.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: Speaking to media Monday following the team’s sixth consecutive loss, Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni expressed confidence in his 26 year old quarterback, saying, “Tanner is out guy.” He was asked directly if he was considering a change at quarterback following McKee’s third straight loss, quickly putting those rumors to rest. McKee appears to be the team’s starting quarterback, at least in the immediate future, as they limp past the half way point of the regular season with a Week 9 meeting against the division rival Giants.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: Tanner McKee completed 23-of-34 passes for 212 yards and one interception in the Eagles’ 27-10, Week 8 loss to the Commanders, adding 25 yards on four carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: The Eagles scored the first 10 points of the game as they looked to be in control early. Things quickly went south following numerous mental mistakes, penalties, and poor execution, eventually leading to the Commanders scoring 27 straight to send Philadelphia to their sixth consecutive loss. The Eagles continue to have no downfield ability while playing through mounting injuries, with their longest play of the game coming on the final play from scrimmage on a meaningless down. That leaves very little room for error with things like penalties, drops, and sacks, all of which were present in Week 8. McKee and the Eagles limp into another divisional matchup in Week 9 against the Giants, where McKee will carry negligible fantasy value.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: Tanner McKee completed 23-of-35 passes for 211 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Eagles’ 38-21, Week 7 loss to the Cowboys, adding one yard on one carry.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: McKee looked to be comfortable in the pocket to start but things quickly unravelled, with the veteran backup unable to improve upon a 21-yard completion to rookie Makai Lemon in the first quarter as he remained incapable of attacking downfield. Lemon would also be the recipient of McKee’s lone touchdown toss, marking the second consecutive start with just one touchdown pass in relief of Jalen Hurts. The offense looked far more functional while Saquon Barkley was on the field, but the veteran back was in and out of the lineup from the second quarter through the fourth, before ultimately being deemed questionable to return and missing the final frame. The Eagles drop their fifth straight for the first time since 2016 as they fall further behind the Giants for the division lead. McKee is not worth rostering ahead of a Week 8 divisional tilt against the Commanders.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: Tanner McKee completed 26-of-45 passes for 215 yards and one touchdown in the Eagles’ 25-14 Week 6 loss to the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: The very first play of the game was a play-action pass where McKee was sacked for an 11-yard loss. That began what was a rough first half for McKee, but he made some nice throws in the second half, including a beautiful over-the-shoulder throw to DeVonta Smith for a touchdown. When McKee wasn’t under pressure, he was happy to stand in the pocket and take shots down the field, which helped Smith and Dallas Goedert put together usable fantasy days, but McKee obviously does not avoid pressure in the pocket the way that Jalen Hurts does. He could put together a solid day next week against a vulnerable Cowboys defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports that the Eagles will decide whether to place Jalen Hurts (blood clot) on short-term injured reserve on Saturday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: Fowler reportedly spoke to “some people who are hopeful” that Hurts can avoid injured reserve. He described the situation as being “very much touch and go” and said Tanner McKee will “probably” start multiple games. The Eagles go on bye in Week 10, so if Hurts does land on injured reserve, the Eagles’ Week 11 game against the Steelers would be his earliest possible return.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: Speaking on the Pat McAfee Show, NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport said he “would describe” Jalen Hurts’ (blood clot) status as being “out indefinitely.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: Hurts’ blood clot was initially a superficial issue in his calf. Unfortunately, the clot has moved and the situation now appears to be quite serious and, per Rapoport, “scary.” Rapoport said Hurts will now undergo treatment, “which, a lot of times, is blood thinners.” If that treatment option is deemed necessary, Hurts would not be allowed to play. Rapoport believes Hurts will be sidelined in Week 6 “and likely beyond.” Tanner McKee is his replacement.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports that Tanner McKee will start for the Eagles until Jalen Hurts’ (superficial blood clot) “medical situation is solved.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: McKee, 26, is a towering pocket passer (6'6/231) with 97 career dropbacks. He has two career starts and has made appearances in two other contests, averaging 6.8 yards per attempt and a 73.8 percent adjusted completion rate. McKee was the subject of trade rumors last offseason, but luckily, the Eagles kept him. He faces a Panthers secondary missing its two starting perimeter cornerbacks, though he has almost exactly 72 hours to get himself ready and the Eagles’ pass-catching corps is banged up. He is a viable QB2 in superflex formats, but he offers a wide range of potential outcomes. McKee is backed up by rookie Cole Payton. NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo thinks the team could reunite with Andy Dalton, whom they released last week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.headline: NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo believes the Eagles could re-sign Andy Dalton.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tanner-mck.analysis: Dalton is “an option” for the Eagles, who are down to two available quarterbacks this week, Tanner McKee and rookie Cole Payton, with Jalen Hurts having been ruled out preemptively due to a superficial blood clot in his calf. The Eagles released Dalton last week. A few teams have reportedly checked in with Dalton since his release, “though there’s familiarity and a clear role in Philly for him if he decides to return.”

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reports teams have “checked in on” Jadeveon Clowney.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: Garafolo noted that the Texans’ game against the Chargers today will go a long way in determining whether the team wants to buy or sell at the trade deadline. Even at 2-5, the team thinks they can make a run at the playoffs. Clowney has been a hired-gun pass-rusher for most of his career. He isn’t starting for Houston and has just 1.5 sacks while playing a career-low 37 percent of the snaps on defense. If the Texans feel that their season is over, he will be one of the easiest players to move on from.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Jadeveon Clowney (knee) is expected to play in Week 4 against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: Clowney hasn’t played since injuring his knee in Week 1. Though he isn’t expected to be a major factor in the Texans’ plans, Houston’s defense hasn’t been the shutdown unit that it was last year. They currently rank as a below-average team in EPA per play allowed. Clowney won’t change their fortunes overnight, but he will hopefully help them make incremental improvements.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: Texans RT Trent Brown (knee/wrist) is questionable for Week 3 against the Colts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: The Texans ruled out RG Ed Ingram (groin) and EDGE Jadevon Clowney (knee). The Colts’ defense has played unimpressively thus far, but hopefully Brown is able to play this week. Losing two offensive line starters is less than ideal.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: Texans ruled out EDGE Jadeveon Clowney (knee) for Week 2 against the Bengals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: Clowney bagged two quarterback pressures and one sack last week. His absence in Week 2 is a plus for Bengals QB Joe Burrow, who logged two limited sessions with back tightness this week before practicing in full.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: Texans EDGE Jadeveon Clowney (knee) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: Clowney is the type of veteran who can play without practicing, but at this point, he is firmly questionable to play. Fortunately, the Texans field a deep, talented pass rush and will be okay without him.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: Texans EDGE Jadeveon Clowney (knee) did not participate in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: Clowney was listed as a non-participant as he deals with a knee injury. This could certainly be a precautionary measure for the veteran, but something to monitor for the Texans’ pass-rush rotation heading into Week 2. Dalton Schultz also did not participate, but was listed as having a rest day and should have no concerns for this week’s matchup against the Bengals.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reports that the Texans agreed to terms with free agent DE Jadeveon Clowney.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: Clowney totaled 8.5 sacks, 40 quarterback pressures, 26 solo tackles and six TFLs with the Cowboys last year. The signing reunites Clowney, 33, with the team that drafted him No. 1 overall in 2014. He played with them through 2018 before bouncing around the league on one- and two-year deals. He remains a very effective player, having posted a career-best 16.8 percent pass-rush win rate just last year. Clowney’s deal reportedly includes a $5.5 million base salary. He can make up to $8 million.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reports the Browns are hosting Jadeveon Clowney for a visit.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: Clowney inked a one-year deal with the Cowboys last offseason and totaled 8.5 sacks. He has become the league’s preeminent gun for hire on defense, posting at least eight sacks with four different teams. The last time Clowney spent more than one year on a roster was from 2021 to 2022 in Cleveland. After trading Myles Garrett this offseason, the Browns could certainly use some extra firepower at EDGE.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: The Athletic’s James Boyd believes the Colts “could consider” signing EDGE Joey Bosa.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: The need is clearly there with second-round pick Jaylahn Tuimoloau, Micheal Clemons and Arden Key competing for the role next to Laiatu Latu at the moment. Boyd also mentions Cameron Jordan, Jadeveon Clowney and Leonard Floyd among others as possibilities. The veteran edge rusher and wideout markets are still unfolding ahead of training camp.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.headline: Cowboys declared DE Jadeveon Clowney, WR Jalen Tolbert, RB Jaydon Blue, DT Jay Toia, DT Perrion Winfrey and OT Tyler Guyton inactive for Week 14 against the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jadeveon-clown.analysis: Clowney (hamstring) attempted to give it a go in warmups after practicing once, a limited session on Wednesday, this week. He will be missed against the Lions’ top-notch offense. The Cowboys have once again declared Blue, the once-exciting rookie, inactive this week. He does not need to be stashed at this time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: Bengals declared S Kyle Dugger, C Connor Lew, OT Myles Hinton, and DT Landon Robinson inactive for Week 9 against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: The Bengals are surprisingly healthy headed into their date with the Falcons in Madrid, Spain. Dugger is the only one of their inactives who is out with an injury. The rest are healthy scratches.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: Bengals declared S Kyle Dugger, C Connor Lew, OT Myles Hinton, WR Mitch Tinsley, and DT Landon Robinson inactive for Week 8 against the Titans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: Dugger is ruled out after not practicing all week due to a quad injury. The rest of the Bengals’ inactives consist of healthy scratches and they enter Week 8 against the Titans with a relatively clean bill of health.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: Bengals signed S Kyle Dugger.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: Dugger was a full-time starter for years in New England before falling out of favor under new head coach Mike Vrabel, starting four of seven games before the Patriots traded him to the Steelers. Now the 30-year-old safety is on his way to Cincinnati, where he’ll presumably start once again. Dugger had 59 total tackles, five passes defended and two interceptions in 16 games (13 starts) in 2025.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: Steelers acquired S Kyle Dugger and a 2026 seventh-round pick from the Patriots in exchange for a 2026 sixth-round pick.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: The Patriots continue to deal defensive players that have fallen out of favor in their current scheme, sending Dugger to the Steelers just minutes after sending Keion White to the 49ers. Both deals were structured the same, with the Pats swapping late-round picks in exchange for giving up the defensive player. Dugger had started all 45 games played for the Patriots from 2022-2024, but started four out of seven games played this season. The veteran has nine career interceptions, 24 passes defended, and 25 tackles for loss over a six-year career. The Steelers had a need at safety with DeShon Elliott week-to-week due to a knee injury suffered in Week 8. Dugger will mix into a Steelers secondary that needs improvement if they are to make a playoff push.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: Patriots declared DE Keion White, S Kyle Dugger, LB Caleb Murphy, DT Eric Gregory, OL Caedan Wallace, WR Efton Chism, and QB Tommy DeVito inactive for Week 8 against the Browns.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: Dugger is set to miss Week 8 with a knee issue that kept him limited in practice and landed him with a questionable tag heading into Sunday. Meanwhile, White is a surprise healthy scratch. Both White and Dugger could be on the trade block ahead of the November 4th trade deadline, but for now the Pats make both inactive against the Browns.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports that the Patriots are “shopping” S Kyle Dugger.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: Rapoport’s report backs up what Jordan Schultz reported on August 20. The Patriots’ new coaching staff is hoping to move on from Dugger. Earlier today, ESPN’s Mike Reiss reported that it has been a “challenging year” for Dugger, who underwent offseason ankle surgery and has played “deep into preseason games” this month.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: NFL insider Jordan Schultz reports the Patriots are open to trading S Kyle Dugger.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: Schultz said the Patriots are keen on getting rid of Dugger ahead of the regular season, and are willing to eat part of his hefty contract to get a deal done. Dugger has been unhappy with his reduced role this offseason. There are several teams interested in acquiring Dugger, graded by Pro Football Focus in 2024 as the league’s fourth worst safety. Dugger last year allowed a completion on 79 percent of the passes that came his way. There’s a good chance he’s on another roster by Week 1.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: The Athletic’s Chad Graff believes Patriots S Kyle Dugger “may not make the team.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: Dugger was playing deep into the fourth quarter with third-stringers in New England’s second preseason game, and he finished 2024 with a ghastly 34.8 PFF coverage grade — by far the worst of his five-year career. The Patriots wouldn’t get much cap relief from releasing Duggar, who is making $14.5 million a season, but Graff believes “they might do it anyway.”

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: Patriots S Kyle Duggar (ankle/quad) is questionable for Week 17 against the Chargers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: Duggar did not practice on Tuesday or Wednesday but was upgraded to a limited participant on Thursday. The veteran safety played through an ankle injury in last week’s loss to the Bills, but the quad injury appears to be something new. In addition to Duggaer, the Patriots also listed safety Jabrill Peppers, LB Sione Takitaki, and offensive tackle Caedan Wallace as questionable, while ruling out cornerback Marcus Jones (hip).

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.headline: Patriots declared S Jabrill Peppers (hamstring) inactive for Week 16 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-dugge.analysis: The Patriots also declared CB Marcus Jones, G Tyrese Robinson, OL Lecitus Smith, QB Joe Milton III (3rd QB) and RB JaMycal Hasty inactive. Peppers and Jones are notable losses for the Patriots’ starting DB group. Fellow starting S Kyle Dugger (ankle/illness) will suit up after practicing in a limited capacity on Thursday and Friday. The Bills’ passing offense should still be able to pick on the Patriots’ short-staffed secondary though.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Falcons placed RB Brian Robinson (hamstring) on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: The timing of the transaction is curious after Robinson missed the previous two games with the injury, potentially signaling a setback in his recovery. Either way, Robinson will now miss the coming four games, at minimum, leaving Bijan Robinson in a clear workhorse role in the immediate future.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Brian Robinson (hamstring) is questionable for the Falcons’ Week 9 game against the Bengals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: Robinson was briefly listed as questionable only for head coach Kevin Stefanski to rule him out shortly after the initial report. Robinson was limited in practice throughout the week, but the Falcons are opting to play it safe, likely hoping another week on the sidelines will lower the chances of re-injury. Rookie WR Zachariah Branch (hamstring) has also been ruled out for the game after picking up an injury in last week’s loss to the Buccaneers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Brian Robinson (hamstring) was limited in Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: Robinson should be good to go for Week 9, though we won’t get official word on his status until tomorrow. He’ll reclaim the RB2 role in Atlanta once he gets cleared for action. Robinson will be a touchdown-or-bust RB4 if active.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Brian Robinson (hamstring) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: Robinson has missed the past two weeks with the hamstring issue. A limited session today puts him on track to return to the lineup against the Bengals on Sunday. Robinson had at least seven carries in every game before going down in Week 6. He will be in the RB4 mix if he gets the green light for Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) will not play in Week 8 against the Buccaneers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: Robinson will miss a second straight game with his hamstring injury, which positions Khalil Herbert to again serve as the backup to Bijan Robinson. Herbert rushed two times for nine yards in last week’s win over the 49ers while adding one reception for 19 additional yards. He will not be on the streaming radar this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Brian Robinson (hamstring) did not practice Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: He hasn’t practiced since before Week 6 and looks likely to be ruled out again on Friday. Khalil Herbert ran in Robinson’s place as the backup last week and would handle those duties again against Tampa on Sunday if Robinson is ruled out.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Brian Robinson (hamstring) did not practice on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: Bijan Robinson handled 20 carries and five targets with his backup, Brian Robinson, sidelined in Week 7. The backup should be considered questionable to play at this time, though he could make a late-week return. Stay tuned.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) won’t play in Atlanta’s Week 7 game against the 49ers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: Bijan should get a larger-than-usual workload this week against San Francisco. The Falcons only have two running backs on the 53-man roster so it may be Khalil Herbert or Jam Miller filling in as (Bijan) Robinson’s backup on Sunday. Herbert seems like the logical choice.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: The Falcons’ No. 2 running back was limited yesterday. This series of events suggests Robinson strained his hamstring on Wednesday, putting him on the wrong side of questionable for the Falcons’ Week 6 game against the 49ers. Bijan Robinson would handle a few extra touches in Robinson’s absence. The team does not have a third running back on the active roster.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.headline: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brian-robi.analysis: Robinson is the immediate backup to Bijan Robinson in the Falcons’ backfield, seeing his best usage in run-heavy game scripts. He was limited with a hamstring injury on Wednesday but is still trending to play Week 7 against the 49ers, barring setbacks. Also limited was Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder). Both players are depth options at best behind the Falcons’ star-studded skill players.
